title: Mixed Event — You deserve it! Break Time! — Episode8 The Happy Blue Penguin

meta.Event Outline: As the livestreaming gains momentum, Haruka endeavors to create new content to keep viewers engaged. Balancing daily practice, training, school studies, and idol activities, Haruka devotes herself without a moment's rest, causing Shizuku to worry.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, Airi! You're back...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait. There were so many people in line during checkout.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
Did you get anything?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We did! Look!
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, penguin keychains...?
They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! That's why we got a whole set of them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, four in different colors!
It was hard to say no to these...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so nice.
Thank you for getting these.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And this one's yours, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks... It's absolutely adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's such a softie when it comes to penguins too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! She's always so helpful and reliable, which is why the face she makes when she's looking at them is so cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does this count as enjoying myself...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These sort of answers always seem to be right under our noses.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right under our noses...?
Like a happy little blue penguin?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
You would think a blue penguin would be easy to find too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A blue penguin?
What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nothing. Just an inside joke.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would it be alright if we go to one last place before we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a little out of the way, so we may end up staying out a bit later than we planned...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm completely okay with that!
I'll go where you go, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that okay with you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
Penguin Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! So many penguin-themed goods!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...!
Penguin cushions, penguin piggy banks, penguin-themed curtains... So much stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And the menu's filled with penguins too!
This penguin macaron looks so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I never knew this place existed... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So cute...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is this your first time coming here too, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
A girl in my class told me about this place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been meaning to go, but I haven't had the chance to because of other things I've also been wanting to do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I need to thank you, Shizuku, for giving me this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka! You have to see this menu!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This! The Deluxe Emperor Penguin Parfait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's really big and they put a little emperor penguin figure on top! You even get to keep it if you order it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right...! It looks so good, and really cute too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Careful, Minori...
Haruka isn't allowed to have any sugary sweets right now, remember?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*! I forgot...!
I'm so sorry, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it's okay with everyone else, would you mind sharing one together...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's that... I kind of want the penguin figure that comes with it. I can at least eat the citrusy fruits that come with it too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to try it too.
Would you two like to as well...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you want to get it, Haruka, I'm in too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's get it♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Here you are!
The Deluxe Emperor Penguin Parfait!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa! It's bigger than I thought it would be!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But it looks so good♪
I should take a picture...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, me too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's gonna block out the light from that angle, so why not try from Shizuku's side?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I'll try from over there then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? This penguin has a baby with it...?!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
Only one in ten of these figures is paired as parent and child like this! Today's your lucky day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's great, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They're a family...?!
I can have this?! Are you really sure?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We had our share of mishaps today...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I was able to see Haruka smile like this in the end.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, I'll start divvying up the parfait. Mind handing me some of those plates?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. Let's see... Plates... Plates...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I need to be careful not to break any...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll be fine, Shizuku!
I'll catch them if you do drop any!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why is it that I don't find that reassuring at all...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay... Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
